# VI LOGIX Shipment Tracking

> Public shipment status lookup for VI LOGIX orders.

Use a VI LOGIX tracking number to view the current status, estimated delivery, route progress, customs checkpoint and shipment activity. Public results exclude recipient contact details, addresses and shipment charges.

## Public pages

- [Track Your Shipment | VI LOGIX](https://track.vilogx.co/): Track a VI LOGIX shipment from Vietnam-side receiving and preparation through international transit and delivery updates.

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://track.vilogx.co/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots](https://track.vilogx.co/robots.txt)
